whyThisMatters:
All-in-one platform helping US adult day care centers and HCBS (Medicaid waiver) agencies pass audits, halve documentation time, and get claims paid faster. Pricing: 299 dollars a month platform fee + 7.99 dollars per active participant; ERA module 99 dollars a month + 0.10 dollars per claim; billing module 1.50 dollars per submitted claim; BAA available. ~50 estimated users.

Peak Conductor energy — Medicaid paperwork, audits, ERA files and claims. Replaces spreadsheets and paper forms. Customers can't skip compliance, and per-participant pricing scales with the center.

The customer is a US adult day care center or a Medicaid waiver agency. The job is the audit file, the notes, and the claim. You pay a platform fee plus a charge for each person, with extra modules for the payment files and the billing. A health-data agreement is available. The founder puts the user count around fifty. The Stripe connection last synced in April 2026, so the monthly figure is not this month.
